correctness.rationale: All words and signed cellular differentials are explicitly enumerated for n=3,4,5. Consecutive integer boundary compositions vanish. Unimodular top Smith reductions give (1^3), (1^11,2), (1^56,2^4), with top differential injective. Lower boundary ranks are (2,3), (3,9,12), (4,16,44,60), independently checked modulo multiple primes; a second SymPy Smith computation reproduced the integer invariants. The common lower skeleton with Inj([n]) yields (n-3)-connectivity using the Björner–Wachs theorem, completing the homology classification. These finite checks cannot prove n>=6.

value.rationale: Even permutations form the canonical index-two subgroup of S_n. A4 and A5 provide natural, small, fully specified regular permutation complexes with higher integral two-torsion, respectively one and four independent classes. This is a meaningful distinction from torsion-free complete word complexes, shellable subfamilies and the free-pi1 theorem. The finite benchmark is reusable and exhaustive on its stated n=3,4,5 domain without claiming a general formula.
